description: ADCOS Resource object: a consumable or reservable quantity (spec/architecture.md §6.8, §17). The kind enum is the frozen §17 resource list; additions are deliberate additive schema changes (minor version bump per spec/governance.md §3), never silent extensions. Resource accounting, validity/expiry semantics, and measurement are owned by WORK-008; economic settlement is explicitly out of scope (§17).

availability.description: Availability mode; the frozen §17 list. Technical resource admission is separate from economic settlement.

kind.description: Resource kind; the frozen §17 list. Technology-neutral: no access technology or radio generation appears here.

quantity.description: Resource quantity/measurement; accounting semantics owned by WORK-008.

title: ADCOS Resource
